         return "2024-05-15T15:00:00"
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _time_to_minutes(time_str: str) -> int:
+        """Convert 'HH:MM:SS' (optionally suffixed '+1') to minutes after midnight of the departure day."""
+        days = 0
+        if "+" in time_str:
+            time_str, extra = time_str.split("+", 1)
+            days = int(extra or 0)
+        hours, minutes = (int(x) for x in time_str.split(":")[:2])
+        return days * 24 * 60 + hours * 60 + minutes
+
+    def _flight_schedule(self, flight_number: str, date: str) -> dict:
+        """Scheduled times, duration and status of one flight on one date."""
+        flight = self._get_flight(flight_number)
+        dep = flight.scheduled_departure_time_est
+        arr = flight.scheduled_arrival_time_est
+        minutes = self._time_to_minutes(arr) - self._time_to_minutes(dep)
+        if minutes < 0:
+            minutes += 24 * 60
+        status = flight.dates[date].status if date in flight.dates else "unknown"
+        return {
+            "flight_number": flight_number,
+            "date": date,
+            "origin": flight.origin,
+            "destination": flight.destination,
+            "scheduled_departure_time_est": dep,
+            "scheduled_arrival_time_est": arr,
+            "duration_minutes": minutes,
+            "duration": f"{minutes // 60}h {minutes % 60:02d}m",
+            "status": status,
+        }
+
+    def _cancellation_check(self, reservation: Reservation, reason: str) -> Optional[str]:
+        """Return None if policy allows cancelling, else the reason it is refused."""
+        statuses = [
+            self._flight_schedule(f.flight_number, f.date)["status"]
+            for f in reservation.flights
+        ]
+        if any(st in ("flying", "landed") for st in statuses):
+            return (
+                "A portion of this reservation has already been flown, so you cannot cancel it. "
+                "Per policy, transfer the user to a human agent if they insist."
+            )
+        created = datetime.fromisoformat(reservation.created_at)
+        now = datetime.fromisoformat(self._get_datetime())
+        if now - created <= timedelta(hours=24):
+            return None
+        if any(st == "cancelled" for st in statuses):
+            return None
+        if reservation.cabin == "business":
+            return None
+        if reservation.insurance == "yes" and reason in ("health", "weather"):
+            return None
+        return (
+            f"Reservation {reservation.reservation_id} is NOT eligible for cancellation: it was booked "
+            f"at {reservation.created_at} (more than 24 hours ago), no flight in it was cancelled by "
+            f"the airline, the cabin is {reservation.cabin} (not business), and "
+            + (
+                f"the reason '{reason}' is not covered by travel insurance (insurance covers only health or weather)."
+                if reservation.insurance == "yes"
+                else "it has no travel insurance."
+            )
+            + " Do NOT cancel it. Tell the user it cannot be cancelled under the policy, "
+            "then continue with any other request they have."
+        )
